notes.title: Patch 2025 was just released
notes.notes:
Hey guys,

It's been a while since the last update of Casual Pixel Warrior - the casual top-down RPG-like wave shooter. So here it is!

One of the bigger additions is basically under the hood, but will repeatedly be revealed on certain events: the seasonal quests feature.

[img]https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/1807240/ss_0be4c6b1121d4fb29df67b165310e753b22c30c5.jpg?t=1745702358[/img]

The internal seasonal quest feature has been expanded so that it can now dynamically fetch various additional resources:

[list]
[*]IEntity scripts
[*]Graphical assets
[*]Sound files
[*]Properties
[/list]

This allows way more rich-experienced seasonal events: Imagine your base being x-massy on christmas with christmas trees, snow and presents. Or a cool spooky quest on Halloween. Or an egg hunt on easter. Or anything else. All this is now possible!

[img]https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/1807240/ss_25306e4efb2556fdeda06522c2f2da0f335c0aa5.jpg?t=1745702358[/img]

Another thing - as part of a huge update decision across all my games - is that the game now uses windowed fullscreen! Thus you can now minimize the game or move out with your mouse. The game won't crash or hang anymore. This is an essential feature that plays an important role in the players experience.

[img]https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/1807240/ss_af3ee299541b11c2f951ab9f6040c6c629615297.jpg?t=1745702358[/img]

I also added coin and gem pick up sounds. Whenever you collect coins or gems, the game will now play an indicator sound. This makes the game even more interactive, providing a better gameplay experience.

[img]https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/1807240/ss_c8da98ac21cbf8ad7db171649718e564da2e03cd.jpg?t=1745702358[/img]

Also the loading screen has been improved a bit. Sure, there is still room for improvement, but it's a right step in the right direction.

Have fun with the update!

Kind Regards

notes.title: New Years Event
notes.notes:
On December 31st, 2023 we will run a new years event, that gives you an opportunity to win 100 gems!

This is in order to thank you for playing Casual Pixel Warrior. It won't be pretty different to the christmas special event, altough it gives you a greater time frame to solve the quest!

What do you have to do?
- Collect 500 coins
- Frag 250 enemies

Do this in one match and then you can earn 100 gems!

We hope you are having great holidays and wish you a happy new year 2024!

We are also planning new updates for the next year and will inform you about that.

notes.title: Pet feeding is now enabled!
notes.notes:
Hi guys,

I've just published an update that changes the game so that you have to feed your pets in order for them to continue producing coins. 

While the pets produce coins their hunger value increases and at some point they will stop making coins. You can see that they are hungry/angry when they have a cloud on their heads. You can obtain food for the pets in the shop using coins. Each pet has their special food and does only eat that particular food. Feeding works by approaching a pet and dropping/throwing the food using the THROW key. The game automatically checks which pet is the closest one and thus selects the appropriate food to drop automatically.

Have fun!

notes.title: Big update coming soon!
notes.notes:
Hey guys,

I have decided that Casual Pixel Warrior will change massively with the next update.

Before that the game was intended to just be iterative: You proceed from map to map and after you have finished all levels the game would be finished.

I figured that this is a bit boring. So I have decided to implement massive changes, so that gameplay will be as follows:
- Instead of proceeding from map to map, you can play each map whenever you want and the waves go infinitely
- This means playing a map is like a classic wave shooter: Defeat more and more waves and lead the leaderboards!
- Fragging enemies will, as currently is, drop some coins
- You can use these coins in the shop to buy upgrades: Ammo, weapons and more maps
- The better weapons you got / there more ammo you have the longer will you be able to last the waves. How long will you be able to last?

This massive change will ensure much more that the game has some replay value. Because basically it never ends.

After the release I will push more minor updates wich are planned to provide more weapons and maps.

So, stay tuned for the next BIG update!

Kind regards

PS: If you still like the old concept, you might want to check out Solitarius. It is planned to remain its gameplay style. The only difference is, that it is set in a sci-fi space environment.

notes.title: Almost close to a finished first open beta EA version
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

We are almost close to a first open beta release of the EA version of Casual Pixel Warrior.

The game is now playable, but there are just a few things to fix and to replay it to see how it feels to actually be played.

Then I will be releasing a first version, where the community can play the game and report feedback of what needs to be improved or bugfixed.

The game type will remain as a small wave shooter where you have to actually make it through the levels instead of just surviving as long as possible on a single level. 

Currently the game as four levels: Level 1 to 3 contain several different grouped enemies which you have to fight. The last level will contain a boss fight where you have to fight the boss and then, like in the previous levels, have to escape via the opened portal.

I will also post a gameplay video soon!

Kind regards
